description: This file defines an immutable class 'ImmutableFilteredTopic' implementing 'FilteredTopic', with methods for parsing, building, and representing filtered topics, including URL query parameter handling and JSON field selection.

classes.name: ImmutableFilteredTopic
classes.description: Immutable implementation of FilteredTopic with parsing, string representation, and equality methods.

classes.name: ImmutableFilteredTopicBuilder
classes.description: Fluent builder class for constructing ImmutableFilteredTopic instances.

classes.name: FilteredTopicStringParser
classes.description: Private static class for parsing a string into an ImmutableFilteredTopic object.

methods.name: getBuilder
methods.description: Returns a builder for creating an ImmutableFilteredTopic.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Creates an ImmutableFilteredTopic from its string representation.

methods.name: getTopic
methods.description: Returns the topic associated with this filtered topic.

methods.name: getExtraFields
methods.description: Returns the optional extra JSON fields selector.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the length of the string representation.

methods.name: charAt
methods.description: Returns the character at the specified index in the string representation.

methods.name: subSequence
methods.description: Returns a subsequence of the string representation.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the filtered topic, including query parameters.
